# Beowulf — questions for the owner

Each entry: date · part · the question · what the run decided meanwhile.

- 2026-09-30 · fitts XXIX/XXX · Klaeber prints [XXVIIII–XXX] at 2039 and no break at 2093. **Answered by the owner the same day:** keep the July split at 2093 and say that Klaeber does not mark it (done in the source statement and in the first note of each part).
- 2026-09-30 · display · Klaeber's metrical dot under a vowel (dōgọra) is kept in the text as printed (66 in the poem); the owner may ask for the reader to hide it.
- 2026-10-11 · beowulf-fitt-03 · Cruces rendered from the lexica and flagged as guesses in the notes: eoletes (224, left untranslated in `l`), māga gemēdu (247, "consent"), ǣgwearde (241). Decided meanwhile: published as flagged; the owner may revisit.
- 2026-10-11 · beowulf-fitt-04 · (a) fitt-03 `l` at 234 says "meeting-words" but the conventions table records "speech-words" for meþelwordum; fitt-04 uses "speech-words". Which stands? (b) Cruces gūþmōdgum men / ferhwearde (305–306) rendered as guesses and flagged in the notes. Decided meanwhile: published as flagged.
- 2026-10-11 · beowulf-fitt-06 · Cruces rendered from the lexica and flagged as guesses in the notes: (a) fīfe geband (420, "bound five") is disputed — the apparatus lists fīfel / fīfelgeban / fīfla gebann as alternatives, and Klaeber's ‘fīfe’ has no noun; (b) heo[r]ðe (404, "hearth"; Bugge's hlēoðe "hearing" the alternative); (c) wonhȳdum (434, "lack-of-heed"/"recklessness", an obscure word); (d) mearcað mōrhopu (450, "marks the moor-hollows", sense uncertain); (e) mægenhrēð (445, "might-glory", apposed to lēode; other editors split or change it); (f) unforhte (444, taken as the adverb "fearlessly", the adjective reading noted); also Gēotena (443), ealdfæder (373, "father", elsewhere "grandfather"), sibbegedriht (387), mōdþræce (384), ārstafum (382, "favors", after fitt-04 316), haðor (414), and the fitt-wide ǣglǣca/āglǣca rendering "the awesome one" (disputed word, per fitt-02). Decided meanwhile: published as flagged; the owner may revisit.
- 2026-10-12 · beowulf-fitt-07 · (a) 489–490 onsǣl meoto / sigehrēð secgum is disputed (many readings in the apparatus: Kemble, Thorkelin, Grein, Dietrich, Holthausen, Schücking, Sedgefield, Bright and others); rendered as in units.json ("give thought to victory-glory for the men" in `i`, ‘onsǣl meoto’ left in Old English in `l`, "victory-glory to men" for ‘sigehrēð secgum’). (b) Other guesses flagged in the notes: ‘Ār-’ in Ār-Scyldinga (464, "honor"), fǣrnīða (476, "sudden-malices"), dolsceaðan (478, "mad-ravager"), bestȳmed (486, "bespattered"), hādor (497, "clearly"), ārstafum-stafum (457), the 457 opening gewyrhtum (emended; many alternatives), and ‘mid gryrum ecga’ (483, whose blades). Decided meanwhile: published as flagged.
- 2026-10-12 · beowulf-fitt-08 · Cruces rendered from the lexica and flagged as guesses in the notes: (a) 525 wyrsan geþingea ("worse outcome"; ending unclear, editors' geþinges); (b) 530 sprǣce taken as dative noun "in talk" rather than a second verb — a judgment call, noted in the note; (c) 524 Bēanstānes (unknown name; Bānstānes/Bēahstānes proposed); (d) 508 wada, 513 ēagor-, 554 fāh, 555 gyfeþe, 519 Heaþo-Rǣmas (identity not given); (e) 499/530 Unferð (MS Hunferð; Klaeber's italic Un is Rieger's change). Also: the root glossary entries for niht and ðǣr contain a line number / "here" wording from earlier parts. Decided meanwhile: published as flagged.
